covid-hospitalizations.note: Patients in hospital with a confirmed diagnosis, summed across reporting states. HHS ended the reporting requirement this series was built on, so it stops here.

covid-hospitalizations-va.note: Patients in hospital with a confirmed diagnosis, summed across reporting states. HHS ended the reporting requirement this series was built on, so it stops here.

covid-weekly-admissions.note: Weekly US hospital admissions with confirmed COVID-19. The hub was archived in November 2024 and the series ends here.

debt-limit.note: Millions of dollars. Ceiling is blank while suspended.
debt-limit.source: Treasury Fiscal Data - Daily Treasury Statement

faamg-revenues.note: Billions of US dollars, by each company's own fiscal year. Combined is blank for years where not all five have filed.

flu-hospitalizations.note: Weekly hospital admissions with a confirmed influenza diagnosis.

hpai-depopulations.note: Birds killed in confirmed commercial and backyard flocks. The CDC mirror has not been updated since this date; the outbreak itself has not stopped.
hpai-depopulations.source: CDC mirror of USDA APHIS confirmed detections

refugee-admissions.note: Monthly arrivals. Fiscal years run October-September; the annual file carries the presidential ceiling.

semiconductors-china-imports.note: US dollars. Chips are HS 8542; equipment is HS 8486, 903082, 903141, 854311 and 901041, summed.

semiconductors-us-exports-china.note: US dollars. Chips are HS 8542; equipment is HS 8486, 903082, 903141, 854311 and 901041, summed.

va-vaccinations.note: People in Virginia by vaccination status. VDH stopped publishing this series in September 2023; the history is complete.

va-vaccinations-by-age.note: People in Virginia by vaccination status. VDH stopped publishing this series in September 2023; the history is complete.

vdh-cases-by-age.note: Cumulative counts by age band. VDH retired this dataset and kept only five months of it; everything before 2024-04-17 is gone. See fetch_vdh_age.py for what was ruled out.
